title: FinitePushforwardCohomologyComparison
statement: Let $k$ be algebraically closed, $(X,F)$ a torsion curve coefficient pair [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting], $Y$ a curve over $k$, and $f:X\to Y$ finite over $k$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. Convert $F$ and $f_*F$ to $\operatorname{ULift}\mathbb Z$-module sheaves, and write $A_X,A_Y$ for their underlying abelian sheaves. For each $q\ge0$ there is an additive equivalence $H^q(Y,A_Y)\simeq H^q(X,A_X)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology].

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Section 03SB, Lemma 0A5D (lemma-finite-pushforward-statements); its proof uses Proposition 03QP (vanishing of R^qf_* for finite f), the Leray spectral sequence (Cohomology on Sites, Lemma 0733 sites-cohomology-lemma-apply-Leray) and Lemma 0959 (finite pushforward commutes with base change)

proof.text: The counit of the equivalence between Z-modules and abelian groups gives objectwise natural isomorphisms A_X ≅ F and A_Y ≅ f_*F; restriction along ULift.ringEquiv does not change the underlying additive group. Induced maps on cohomology and their inverses form additive equivalences.
